accounting: Persist dispatch before each call and raw response, exact model, reasoning configuration, usage and gateway cost afterwards. Gateway-reported cost is authoritative. Missing cost remains explicitly unknown; distinguish fallback estimates from billed cost. No implicit retry of an unacknowledged request.
scope: Only native R3-required contexts blocked by missing or unusable PMC source and a verified Europe PMC PMID-linked preprint with accessible full text. No title/abstract-only substitution for full text; no new screening of unrelated or completed evidence.
source_policy: Separate preprint-source overlay. Published PMID and journal publication date anchor article identity and cohort ordering; preprint identifier, DOI, version, posted date, retrieval URL, link note and source checksum are retained separately. No original evidence is overwritten. Default include_preprints is false.
